notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (internal IT/helpdesk) evaluating Redwood. Goal: a fast, reliable internal chat assistant for employees (ticket creation, triage, KB lookup).

Key requirements / quotes:
- Workload: chat/agent for internal IT + ticket triage and KB summarization. Integrations: Slack + MS Teams + internal ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow) + CMDB tool calls.
- Latency SLOs: interactive streaming experience required. Target: token-to-client streaming latency <200ms typical, end-to-end reply under 500ms for short answers. "Users will abandon slow bots" — Head of Product.
- Throughput: ~200 concurrent agents expected during business hours; spikes up to ~600 concurrent during incidents.
- Model preferences: open-models preferred (cost control) but willing to use Redwood-curated variants; need guidance on quantization vs quality tradeoffs.
- Features needed: streaming, function/tool-calling for ticket creation + runbook lookup, prefix/KV caching for common KB queries, structured output for automated ticket fields.
- Security & compliance: SSO/SAML, audit logs per-user, configurable retention (need to retain internal chat logs 2 years, redact PII), customer-managed KMS for secrets, ability to limit model training on customer data (no fine-tuning/retention).
- Deployment path: Start hosted API POC (2 weeks) to validate latency & tool-calls. If SLOs or predictable cost/throughput are blockers, move to Dedicated (reserved capacity) for production.
- Cost sensitivity: Finance wants unit-cost estimates for tokens and cost for Dedicated reservation vs hosted consumption. Need a sample runbook of token usage for 10k daily interactions.

POC asks from PivotLine:
- Redwood SE to help pick model variant and batching config for streaming SLOs.
- Example config for prefix caching on KB queries + sample throughput numbers.
- Pricing scenario: 2-week POC (hosted) -> pilot (3 months) -> production (Dedicated). Breakdowns per-month for each stage.

Current sentiment: Positive but cautious. Product/Infra want latency proof; Security needs written retention & KMS commitments before pilot escalates.

Stitched artifacts: pricing deck + security FAQ shared in Drive. Gmail thread open with finance on pricing. Jira ticket INF-2219 opened for security follow-ups.
